pov.title: Every organisation has two versions of itself.
paragraphs: One lives on paper: the policies, the organisation chart, the budget, the process map. The other is how the work really gets done: numbers rebuilt by hand at month-end, payments that never quite reconcile, approvals waiting on one person, decisions made without the facts.

Most organisations try to close the gap with more software. Mail in one tool, accounts in another, customers in a third, conversations in a fourth. Each tool does its job. None of them can tell you how the organisation is doing.
We close it differently. We design how the organisation should run, then build the one system that runs it that way and answers for it. Ask it anything, and it answers.

system.title: One system that runs the organisation, and answers for it.
system.lead: We build the operating system an organisation runs on: money, people, operations, risk and customers in one place, designed around the way it works, with intelligence in every layer.

pillars.title: Designed around you
pillars.body: We start from how your organisation works, not from a product. Your processes, controls, roles and numbers shape the system, never the other way round.

pillars.title: One source of truth
pillars.body: Every transaction, approval and document is recorded once, in one place. Finance, operations and leadership read the same numbers.

pillars.title: Intelligence on your own data
pillars.body: Ask a question in plain language and get a straight answer, a chart, a table or a drafted action, from your own records, limited to what each person is allowed to see.

pillars.title: Built to grow for decades
pillars.body: A solid foundation first. Each new capability is then added as another floor, so nothing is rebuilt as you grow.

problems.title: The hard problems we solve.
problems.lead: Clients do not come to us for software. They come with problems that cost them money, time and confidence. These are some of the ones we solve every day; the list grows with every engagement.

items.problem: Payments arrive through several gateways and never quite match the bank.
items.answer: Gateway integrations with settlement monitoring and automatic reconciliation: every payment matched to its invoice, every settlement to the bank, exceptions raised the same day.

items.problem: A gateway fails quietly, and sales are lost before anyone notices.
items.answer: Real-time gateway health monitoring that watches every provider, alerts the right people the moment one degrades, and routes payments to a healthy one where the business allows.

items.problem: Invoices, receipts and debts live in different places, in different currencies.
items.answer: Invoicing, collections and receivables in one ledger, in any currency, with every balance and its due date in view.

items.problem: Leadership waits days for numbers that are already out of date.
items.answer: Live business analytics drawn from the records the teams work in, so the numbers are current when the meeting starts.

items.problem: The data is too large, or too scattered, to be useful.
items.answer: Big data pipelines that bring every source together, clean it once and make it ready for analysis, forecasting and AI.

items.problem: Forecasts are rebuilt by hand in spreadsheets every quarter.
items.answer: Financial models and forecasts built on the organisation's own history, refreshed as new data arrives.

items.problem: Approvals wait in one person's inbox.
items.answer: Approval chains, thresholds and delegations set as rules, applied the same way every time, with a complete trail.

items.problem: Work in the field is invisible to head office.
items.answer: Field reporting with location check-ins, offline work that syncs when the signal returns, and live views for every manager.

items.problem: Hiring, attendance, performance and payroll sit in separate spreadsheets.
items.answer: One record for every person, from application to payslip.

items.problem: Nobody can say who changed what, or why.
items.answer: Every action permissioned and logged: who, what, when and from where.

items.problem: Sensitive information is visible to too many people.
items.answer: Access by role, down to each page and record, set by the organisation itself.

items.problem: Compliance deadlines are discovered when they are missed.
items.answer: Obligations generated from each registration, assigned to an owner and announced well before they fall due.

items.problem: Conversations by email, WhatsApp, Instagram and the website are scattered across phones.
items.answer: One inbox on each customer's record, with every conversation, order and invoice in one place.

items.problem: Marketing, advertising and sales run in tools that never talk to each other.
items.answer: Campaigns, content calendars and advertising performance connected to the customer record, so spend can be traced to revenue.

items.problem: A dozen subscriptions, and not one of them agrees with another.
items.answer: One system in place of the patchwork of mail, accounting, CRM, chat, project and scheduling tools, with your data in one place that you own.

problems.closing: If it moves money, people, goods or decisions, we can design it and build it.

work.title: Selected work.
work.lead: Each system below runs in production or is being built. Where a client is not named, we describe it by its sector.

items.title: A freight business where every shipment file reaches the books.
items.problem: Its older system had no accounting layer and worked in English only, in a country that works in French and English.
items.built: Praxis LS: shipment files, warehouse, fleet, people and OHADA accounting in one bilingual system.
items.outcome: Invoices, file costs, purchases and payroll post to one ledger as the work happens, and tax deadlines remind the people responsible.

items.title: A global hair brand, run in English and Chinese, from the factory to the customer.
items.problem: The brand manufactures in China and is registered in China, the United States and Nigeria. Factory, freight, stock and sales lived in separate places, in different languages.
items.built: One platform from the factory floor to the customer: production batches, factory accounts and freight in Chinese for the factory team; costing, stock, the brand's own online shop, deliveries, people and accounts in English.
items.outcome: The factory and head office work in one system, each in its own language. Every unit is costed from production to landed cost, and every channel draws on one stock count.

items.title: A national sales force, its managers and its forecast, on one platform.
items.problem: Managers could not see field visits and orders as they happened, and forecasts were assembled by hand.
items.built: A platform for representatives, managers and leadership: verified visits, offline work that syncs, and a national forecast.
items.outcome: Visits are checked in where they happen, nothing is lost offline, and the platform runs in the client's own cloud account.

items.title: An ERP rebuilt in stages, while the business kept using it.
items.problem: A distributor's system had to be rebuilt without stopping orders, deliveries or the books.
items.built: Orders, deliveries, returnable containers, fleet, payroll and OHADA accounts, released in stages, with checks before each go-live.
items.outcome: Access by role, books that refuse unbalanced entries and keep closed years closed, and every change on the record.

items.title: Field work that keeps pace with the rig.
items.problem: Reports, approvals and purchases lagged behind operations that run around the clock.
items.built: Real-time rig tracking, daily drilling reports that build themselves, work tickets that need two signatures, and a procurement pipeline.
items.outcome: Daily reports no longer wait to be assembled by hand, and every ticket carries two signatures.

items.title: A small business's records, on the phone it already uses.
items.problem: Owners sell through chats and word of mouth, with their records spread across notebooks and messages.
items.built: A website for each business, plus orders, invoices, receipts, debts, stock and deliveries on the phone.
items.outcome: Live in Nigeria, Cameroon, Ghana and Kenya, each with its own currency and its own way to pay.
